breakdown.description: When a specimen is weighed while immersed, buoyancy reduces the apparent weight, so the immersed mass should be smaller than the saturated-in-air mass, not larger.
breakdown.reason: The ground truth corrects the immersed mass to 8.6 g (which is physically consistent, being less than both dry and saturated masses). The generated specification retains the incorrect immersed mass of 13.6 g from the incomplete prompt and merely notes that the ordering is inconsistent, rather than correcting the value to 8.6 g as the ground truth does.
